caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a silver creamer, which is a small pitcher-like vessel with a bulbous body, a narrowed neck, a wide spout, and an elaborately curved handle extending from the upper body to above the rim. The creamer stands on a round, flared pedestal base. The drawing is rendered in pencil on a light beige or off-white sheet of paper, with shading used to suggest the reflective surface and rounded form of the creamer. At the upper left, the text “SILVER CREAMER” and “HEIGHT 6 1/2"” is written, while in the lower right, there is additional handwritten information including “American Wing Met. Museum” and reference numbers, along with the name “John Garay.” The background is plain, and the focus is entirely on the detailed representation of the creamer itself.
title: Silver Pitcher
